name: Ever Spire
storyline: The kingdom has fallen and only one tower still stands. Across five chapters, from the Fringe to the Ashlands, it holds the line against the Ogre King, the Goblin Warchief, the Lich, the Colossus and, last of all, the Ash King.
summary: Ever Spire is an isometric roguelite tower defense game set in a medieval fantasy kingdom. The player defends a single tower at the center of the map while endless waves of enemies converge on it from every side. Gold earned during a run upgrades the tower, and every five waves the player drafts a card from a random selection. The tower masters one of three elements (Fire, Frost, Lightning), can awaken a second one, and casts elemental spells. Three heroes (Barbarian, Mage, Templar) wear equipment with rarities, sets and legendary items. The Story mode spans four biomes and five bosses; the Endless mode then adds Torment difficulty levels and leaderboards. Permanent talent trees carry progress from one run to the next.
